items.title: Report the Barnstable County Cape Cod and Islands Water Protection Fund excise
items.description: Operators of hotels, motels, bed-and-breakfasts, lodging houses and short-term rentals in Barnstable County collect the current 2.75% Cape Cod and Islands Water Protection Fund excise and report it with the Massachusetts room occupancy excise return to the Department of Revenue.
items.deadline: On the assigned Massachusetts room occupancy excise filing schedule

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register; the tax is the amount the return reports.

penalty.note: The state page this entry cites gives no penalty amount.

note: Barnstable County lodging operators must report the 2.75% Cape Cod and Islands Water Protection Fund excise; other county-level business duties were not checked.

Massachusetts Department of Revenue places room occupancy taxes at the state and city/town levels; the only current county-wide Cape Cod and Islands Water Protection Fund excise is in Barnstable County. No county-level business filing applies here.
